Driving Guide, Drop-Off & Parking Details ♡ ▾
Covered Archway Drop-Off

Cars and Grab rides can pull straight through the Main Gate up to the covered red-carpet archway for easy gown & heels drop-off.

Free On-Site Gated Parking

Complimentary guarded guest parking is available inside the venue compound from 5:30 PM until 1:00 AM, guided by marshals.

Best Driving Approach

From Makati/BGC/South: Skyway Stage 3 to Quezon Ave exit, then head to Timog & Tomas Morato. From EDSA: turn directly onto Timog Ave.

Gate Entry & Evening Buffer

Mention "Lily's 18th Birthday" at the security gate for instant entry, and allow a 15-minute buffer for evening Tomas Morato traffic.
